# Royal Rollers

> Royal Rollers LLC is a licensed vehicle transport broker (USDOT 6895738, MC 73292138) based in Far Rockaway, New York. We ship cars state to state across the United States and Canada, with most moves starting in the New York / New Jersey / Connecticut Tri-State area. Customers get a real, priced quote by email, book with a deposit, and the balance is charged automatically on delivery.

## Services
- Carrier Transport: your car rides on an insured, licensed carrier's truck. No miles added. Open or enclosed. Best for long distance and high-value cars.
- Personal Driver: a driver takes your car directly, point to point. More precise timing, mileage is added.
